description: The figure is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating Token Ratio (TR) values across several evaluation sets and an overall average for three models. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmarks labeled (left to right) PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, with each category showing a cluster of three adjacent bars; no explicit horizontal-axis title is shown. The vertical axis represents TR on a linear scale, with values indicated by numeric annotations above bars; the plotted values span from about 0.42 up to 1.00, and no y-axis label or regularly spaced tick marks are visible. In each category, the left bar is dark purple for “RedWhale (our),” the middle bar is light blue for “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0,” and the right bar is light gray for “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base).” The annotated bar values are: PT-EVAL (RedWhale 0.42, EEVE-Korean 0.46, SOLAR base 1.00), KoBEST-BQ (0.52, 0.56, 1.00), KoBEST-CP (0.71, 0.74, 1.00), KoBEST-HS (0.50, 0.54, 1.00), KoBEST-SN (0.69, 0.73, 1.00), and AVG (0.57, 0.61, 1.00). The bars are grouped by category rather than stacked, the category order is as labeled on the x-axis (with AVG placed last), and there is no additional visual emphasis beyond the color-coding and value annotations.
